name: goat-glass-ribbon
description: Glass Ribbon · Шилэн тууз: a violet talking-head look with a glowing ribbon and orbs behind the speaker, a frosted glass card, a white pill and plain white captions from their own speech with a key word in serif italic, and a soft light-streak wipe to a glass scene that acts out what they say (a big number or word, a quote, a before and after, a ticked list, numbered steps, a news panel or a chat). Cuts the pauses and the person out on every frame, built on HyperFrames. Renders a 1080x1920 MP4 for Reels/TikTok.
